name: hcportal_getRunsAtStart
description: The portal's half of E3.F1.S8 (run editing parity): the kennel's other runs at the same local date and time as a run about to be saved, so the editor confirms 'Another run at this time?' on a manual Save. Rule: HC6.RunsAtLocalStart. Missing input or a caller without createEditRuns gets an empty list, never an error.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: The run's kennel, resolved to the internal id at the door.

parameters.name: publicEventId
parameters.description: The run being saved (the public id the portal minted for a new run); never matches itself.

parameters.name: eventStartDatetime
parameters.description: The start exactly as hcportal_addEditEvent will receive it; local wall clock compared, to the minute.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Success = 0 with ErrorMessage on auth failure only; otherwise Success = 1.

rowsets.name: RunsAtStart
rowsets.description: One row per other run of the kennel at that local start; empty = no clash.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
